title: Remove remaining independent source checks: termal-tests.toml hash, UI lockfile hash, watcher veto on carried-check evidence, sha256sum diff guidance; then retired capture helpers and docs
outcome: No TermAl path checks source by its own hashing or by watcher events. Source evidence comes only from the shared source_id. Historical records stay readable, and retired capture code and docs that present old behaviour as current are removed.
acceptance: ACTIVE slice: (1) src/engram_declared_tests.rs:69,88,584 no longer re-reads and SHA-256-hashes termal-tests.toml as source drift (callers src/declared_run_source.rs:145, src/engram_trx_artifact.rs:630,662); declaration parsing and membership stay. (2) scripts/test-ui-bootstrap.mjs:111,137 no longer hashes ui/package-lock.json for drift; dependency setup and validation stay. (3) The watcher veto from src/workspace_watch_observation.rs into src/engram_carried_checks.rs:2021,2052 and src/engram_registered_closing_baseline.rs:120 is removed from source evidence. (4) The `git diff HEAD | sha256sum` guidance in src/acceptance_evaluation.rs:1703,1709, src/claude_read_only_refusal.rs:83,86 and the diff-fingerprint rationale in src/claude.rs:1433,1850,1873 are removed. Behaviour tests cover the changed paths.

HISTORICAL slice: the obsolete capture helpers (git-commit:<HEAD> fixtures in src/ordinary_commit_input.rs, src/engram_source_roots.rs, src/engram_turn_observations.rs; scripts/test-launcher-source.mjs:83 captureSourceMetadata), the test-only toolchain probe (src/engram_check_toolchain.rs, src/engram_build_checks.rs:53, src/engram_turn_checks.rs:1894) and docs/UI text presenting content-v1 or old fingerprints as current are removed; readers of stored historical evidence are kept.
Each slice: the review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
